ct_k_allergies_t: The client tells the business about any allergy or sensitivity before the service. The business tells the client which products or ingredients it uses when asked. The business is not responsible for reactions to something the client did not tell it about.
ct_k_client_materials_t: When the client supplies materials or items, the client makes sure they are suitable and arrive on time. The business is not responsible for their quality or for delays they cause.
ct_k_confidentiality_t: Both sides keep private what they learn about each other's business or personal matters while working together, and use it only for this agreement. This continues after the agreement ends.
ct_k_delivery_t: The business delivers to the address the client gives, on the agreed day. The client checks the order on delivery and tells the business within 24 hours if something is missing or damaged; after that it counts as received in good condition.
ct_k_deposit_kept_t: The deposit holds the date and covers the business's preparation. It is not refunded if the client cancels, but it counts toward the price if the date is moved once with at least 48 hours' notice.
ct_k_health_t: The client tells the business before the service about any health condition, injury, pregnancy or medicine that matters for it. The client takes part at their own risk, follows the business's instructions and stops and tells the business if they feel unwell.
ct_k_installments_t: The balance may be paid in parts on the dates the two sides agree in writing. If a payment is more than 7 days late, the business may pause the work until it is paid and the remaining balance becomes due.
ct_k_membership_t: The membership lasts for the period agreed and renews for the same period unless the client cancels in writing at least 7 days before it ends. The business tells the client before a price change takes effect.
ct_k_minors_t: For a client under the age of adulthood, a parent or legal guardian signs this agreement, agrees to the service on the minor's behalf and is responsible for the payments.
ct_k_no_show_t: If the client is more than 15 minutes late, the time may be shortened or moved. If the client does not come and does not tell the business at least 24 hours before, the business may charge a no-show fee or keep the deposit.
ct_k_overtime_t: Time beyond what was agreed is charged at the business's hourly rate, only when the client asks for it or agrees to it.
ct_k_pets_t: The client tells the business about the pet's health, behavior and vaccinations. The business takes reasonable care of the pet. The client pays for veterinary care that is needed while the pet is with the business, unless the business caused the problem.
ct_k_photos_t: The business may take photos of the finished work and show them in its portfolio and social media, without the client's name or address. The client can say no by telling the business in writing.
ct_k_rental_t: Rented items stay the business's property. The client returns them on time, clean and in the same condition. Late returns may be charged per day; lost or damaged items are charged at their repair or replacement cost.
ct_k_site: Materials and access to the place
ct_k_site_t: The client gives safe access to the place on the agreed days and times, with water and electricity when the work needs them. Materials are bought by the business and charged as agreed. Delays caused by no access may change the dates and the price.
ct_k_travel_t: When the work or service is outside the business's usual area, a travel fee is charged as agreed before the visit.
ct_k_warranty_t: The business guarantees its work for 30 days from delivery against faults in how it was done. Within that time it repairs or redoes the fault at no cost. The guarantee does not cover misuse, normal wear or changes made by others.
ct_k_weather: Weather and events no one controls
ct_k_weather_t: If bad weather or another event no one controls makes the service unsafe or impossible, the two sides agree a new date. Money paid is kept for the new date; if no date can be agreed, the business refunds it minus costs it already had.

If the client cancels at least 48 hours before the agreed date, the business refunds what was paid, minus any costs it already had for this agreement. Later cancellations may not be refunded. If the business cancels, it refunds everything the client paid.
ct_s_changes_t: Changes to what was agreed are made only when both sides agree, in writing. If a change costs more, the business says how much before doing it, and the client agrees before it is done.
ct_s_liability_t: The business will do its work with care. Each side is responsible for damage it causes on purpose or through carelessness. Neither side is responsible for delays or damage caused by events it cannot control. The business's responsibility under this agreement is limited to the amount the client paid for it, unless the law says otherwise.
ct_s_parties_t: This agreement is between {business} ("the business") and {client} ("the client"), who can be reached at {client_contact}. It is dated {today}.
ct_s_price_t: Total price: {price}. Deposit: {deposit}, paid before the work or service starts. Balance: {balance}, due {due}. Payments are made in the ways the business accepts and are confirmed with a receipt.
ct_s_privacy_t: The business keeps the client's name, contact details and the details of this agreement only to carry it out, to send messages about it and to keep the records it must keep. It does not sell them. The client can ask to see, correct or delete their data, unless the business must keep it by law.
ct_s_signatures_t: Both sides have read this agreement and agree to it. It can be signed electronically, and an electronic signature counts the same as one on paper. Each side keeps a copy.
ct_s_what_t: The business will provide: {service}. Anything not written here is not included unless both sides agree to it in writing.
ct_s_when_t: Date and time: {date}. If the business needs more time for reasons it cannot control, it will tell the client as soon as it can and offer a new date.

wf_l_until_now: the date had passed: went on

wf_not_started: Not started: they are already in it.
wf_offset: Days after it (use a minus for before)
